name: Thy Lacking Evidence
source:
A small-town cop becomes obsessed with a cold case from 1978. Three people went missing, and nobody has seen them since. Then one day, in 2008, three people with the same names as those in 1978 go missing. The case is reopened.

[From [url=https://crimsonthedragon.itch.io/thy-lacking-evidence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名小镇警察痴迷于1978年的一桩悬案：三个人失踪，此后再也无人见过他们。直到2008年的某一天，三个与当年失踪者同名的人也消失了。案件因此重新开启调查。

[摘自[url=https://crimsonthedragon.itch.io/thy-lacking-evidence]itch.io[/url]]
